title: Tycoos & Kate Miles - Edge of Paradise (2021)

lines.l: But you don't hear a sound, there's a chance you take when hope is found
Wonder where you are, what you'll find
Edge of paradise, feeling here tonight
Turning all the corners in your mind
Telling all the secrets kept inside
Bringing me closer to the edge of paradise
Feeling the moment when the darkness is the light
And all the secrets kept inside
Bringing you closer to the edge of paradise
Feeling the moment when the darkness sees the light
I know you got me dancing, standing with no other
